page.layout: One column of index entries, top to bottom, with letter headings T and U inside it. Page numbers sit at the right of each entry. No running head, page number or signature. Catchword "Voca." at the lower right.

page.notes: The first line in Arabic or Samaritan script is not legible enough to copy; the page number after it may be 641 or 643. The "452" at the end of Templum Hierosolymitanum is damaged. The word "Volales" is probably a misprint for "Vocales" and is left as printed. The catchword "Voca." is partly worn. The "12." after Valle is a printed numeral and may have a stop.
